title: Example: Mnemuron Production Readiness v0.1
goal: Example task: record correctness, capacity, recovery, and security evidence before considering production readiness.
decisions: production_ready remains false until correctness, event integrity, conflict, capacity, recovery, security, observability, and stability gates all pass with recorded evidence.
Failed attempts remain append-only audit evidence and are not erased by a later successful retry.
Device, Agent, Agent instance, Session, Task, Workstream, Resume, Preview, Receipt, and turn provenance must remain independently attributable.
No full-capture claim is allowed while unexplained Raw unavailability is nonzero; policy-expired Raw records must be reported separately.
Production changes require a recoverable backup, scoped deployment, and post-change verification proportional to risk.
Raw availability is accounted only when every Event is partitioned into Raw available or policy expired and unexplained_raw_unavailable is zero; any unexplained or inconsistent partition is degraded.

A fresh Receipt cycle is accepted by its exact Resume, Receipt, Session, Workstream, and turn evidence; historical unreported confirmations and failed attempts remain separately visible append-only debt and are never erased or relabeled by a later success.

An idempotent restart retry passes only when the original failed attempt remains immutable, the retry receives a fresh attempt ID, both attempts use the intended real conversation Session, the retry reaches a matching terminal ACK, and no unrelated or third attempt claims the Resume.
blockers: Example seed only; deployment-specific acceptance evidence has not been recorded.
next_steps: Configure isolated service and client identities for this example.
Run the documented acceptance checks and record actual results before marking the task complete.
